name: wKeyDAO
fix_description: Add access control to buy() function (e.g., whitelist, onlyOwner, or time-limited sale window). Currently anyone can call buy() to purchase tokens at the configured low price and immediately sell on DEX at market price for profit.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short flash-loan-assisted loop: borrow BUSD, repeatedly call buy() on the vulnerable contract, immediately dump the received token on PancakeSwap, then repay. It involves only a few contracts and a straightforward exploitation pattern without deep protocol internals or complex state reasoning.
